markets.name: MIAMI
markets.copy: The seat of Prince's own lineage, and the city that shaped his name.

markets.name: FORT LAUDERDALE
markets.copy: Here the oldest families keep quiet counsel, and Prince has been in the room for years.

markets.name: MANHATTAN
markets.copy: Where penthouses open the long horizon of legacy.

markets.name: PALM BEACH
markets.copy: Where inherited prestige meets the next chapter of the name.

markets.name: ORLANDO
markets.copy: Where Florida's private lakes keep their own estates.

deals.title: 300 S Pointe Dr #2801 — $4,500,000
deals.copy: Held off-market at Miami's southernmost point. City, bay, and ocean in one turn.

deals.title: Missoni Baia #5201 — $3,250,000
deals.copy: Three closings in this building. The bay, the architecture, and a clientele that stays.

deals.title: Windermere FL — $3,150,000
deals.copy: Nearly an acre, inside a gated community that does not need to introduce itself.

deals.title: Fort Lauderdale / Harbor Inlet — $2,800,000
deals.copy: A private inlet. Minutes from Harbor Beach, and the coastline that holds Fort Lauderdale.

deals.title: 695 1st Ave — $2,335,000
deals.copy: Richard Meier's first black-glass tower, twenty-eighth floor. The Manhattan skyline, unobstructed.

deals.title: 425 NW 119th Ave — $2,000,000
deals.copy: Five bedrooms on three-quarters of an acre. A compound built to be lived in — not merely held.

deals.title: Missoni Baia #1703 — $1,880,000
deals.copy: A second chapter in the same building. Proof the first was not an accident.

deals.title: 1010 Brickell #2505 — $1,400,000
deals.copy: Brickell held at the right altitude. A first address with room to grow the name.

quotes.name: Aman · Buyer · Miami / Fort Lauderdale
quotes.body: Prince has been with me since I rented my first apartment. Years later he is still the person I call — for the next home, and for rooms far outside real estate. *Whatever negotiation I enter, I call him first.*

quotes.name: Seth · Investor · Family Office · Global
quotes.body: I met Prince in college, when he was already closing faster than the rest of us could see the opening. *That instinct is why my family asked him to help expand our legacy.*

quotes.name: Yasmeen · Seller · Fort Lauderdale
quotes.body: He understood what the house meant before I found the words. *After the sale, my mother still invites him to lunch.*

listings.title: Fisher Island residences — $8,900,000
listings.copy: A private-island residence with a private dock. Shown by appointment only.

listings.title: Worth Avenue estate — $6,250,000
listings.copy: Held quietly in Palm Beach. The ocean is a short walk; the guest list is not.

listings.title: Sutton Place duplex — $5,400,000
listings.copy: East River light, two floors, and a doorman who already knows the name.

listings.title: Las Olas waterfront — $3,850,000
listings.copy: Fort Lauderdale's canal line, with a slip that does not wait for a waitlist.

listings.title: Brickell Key penthouse — $2,175,000
listings.copy: A first skyline for a family that intends to stay. Bay views, private elevator.
